name: Parent Responsibility
overview: Scripture clearly assigns parents the responsibility to diligently teach and guide their children in the ways of the Lord, as seen in Deuteronomy 6:6-7 where God's commands are to be impressed upon the heart and communicated continually throughout daily life. Proverbs 22:6 emphasizes training a child in the right path so that they remain faithful into adulthood, while Proverbs 29:15 highlights the importance of discipline to impart wisdom and prevent shame. Ephesians 6:1 and 6:4 further instruct children to obey their parents and fathers specifically to nurture their children with care and godly admonition, avoiding provocation that leads to anger. Together, these verses affirm that parental responsibility is both a spiritual and practical calling to raise children in the nurture and instruction of the Lord.
